examples.en: Ding Ning, you really are something—holding hands and then pretending it never happened?
examples.zh: 丁宁，你这个人，牵手就不承认了？

examples.en: I heard Ding Ning has never had a girlfriend... could he be a confirmed bachelor?
examples.zh: 我听说丁宁从来没有交过女朋友……他该不会是独身主义吧？
